metric: First update of a fresh seed-42 run after one identical warmup update in the same process; pipeline and frozen-teacher caches retained
repeat_rule: One paired run per slice; increase to three pairs if absolute delta is below three_times_spread_seconds. Batch acceptance always uses three pairs.
scope: Metal versus Metal; A4 recovery and replay are outside this batch
a4_existing_thresholds_note: Historical archive only; not an acceptance gate for this batch
exact_comparison: Compare IEEE-754 binary64 bit patterns parsed from full-precision JSON scalars; no F32 cast, display rounding, averaging or epsilon. Require finite values first.

split_k_B.derivation: F32 epsilon = 2^-23. Choose one epsilon absolute floor plus 64 epsilons relative allowance. Observed baseline noise is zero; add no measured-noise allowance. This is a frozen engineering acceptance budget, not a proven bound on reduction error propagated through training.
split_k_B.repeatability: Independent fresh-state repeats of the same B revision must be bit-identical for every scalar at every matched update; no floating atomics.

comparison_controls: Each slice alone versus original baseline; sequential slice versus immediate predecessor with identical earlier optimizations. Exact slices must pass exact equality in both isolated and incremental controls. All cumulative results versus original baseline use the single B budget if B is enabled, otherwise exact equality.
no_tolerance_growth: Same limits at all seven updates and all later slices; no multiplication by update count, song length, number of slices or timing repeats. Report every signed difference and maximum absolute difference per field.
tensor_scope: Scalar norm equality is not tensor equality. Retain slice-specific kernel/output/gradient probes; A4 tensor thresholds are not applied in this batch.
